questions.questionTextEn:
A thin horizontal flat disc of radius $R$ rotates about its vertical symmetry axis with constant angular velocity $\mathbf{\omega} = \omega \hat{z}$. The velocity field of points on the disc is $\mathbf{V} = \mathbf{\omega} \times \mathbf{r} = -\omega y \hat{x} + \omega x \hat{y}$. Which of the following statements is (are) CORRECT?
(A) The divergence of the velocity field is zero: $\nabla \cdot \mathbf{V} = 0$
(B) The curl of the velocity field is zero: $\nabla \times \mathbf{V} = 0$
(C) The curl of the velocity field is $\nabla \times \mathbf{V} = 2\omega \hat{z}$
(D) The circulation of $\mathbf{V}$ around the perimeter boundary of the disc is $2\pi \omega R^2$
optionsEn: The divergence of the velocity field is zero: ∇ · V = 0
The curl of the velocity field is zero: ∇ · V = 0
The curl of the velocity field is ∇ · V = 2ω z^
The circulation of V around the perimeter boundary of the disc is 2π ω R^2
questions.explanationEn:
- $\mathbf{V} = (-\omega y, \omega x, 0)$:
  $$\nabla \cdot \mathbf{V} = \frac{\partial(-\omega y)}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial(\omega x)}{\partial y} = 0 + 0 = 0$$ (Option A is CORRECT).
  $$\nabla \times \mathbf{V} = \hat{z} \left( \frac{\partial(\omega x)}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial(-\omega y)}{\partial y} \right) = \hat{z}(\omega - (-\omega)) = 2\omega \hat{z} \neq 0$$ (Option C is CORRECT, B is FALSE).
- The circulation around the boundary $C$ of radius $R$ using Stokes' theorem is:
  $$\oint_C \mathbf{V} \cdot d\mathbf{r} = \iint_S (\nabla \times \mathbf{V}) \cdot d\mathbf{A} = (2\omega \hat{z}) \cdot (\pi R^2 \hat{z}) = 2\pi \omega R^2$$ (Option D is CORRECT).
Therefore, Options (A), (C), and (D) are correct.
questions.questionTextHi: त्रिज्या $R$ की एक पतली क्षैतिज चकती अपने ऊर्ध्वाधर अक्ष के परितः कोणीय वेग $\mathbf{\omega} = \omega \hat{z}$ से घूर्णन करती है। चकती का वेग क्षेत्र $\mathbf{V} = -\omega y \hat{x} + \omega x \hat{y}$ है। निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
optionsHi: वेग क्षेत्र का अपसरण शून्य है: ∇ · V = 0
वेग क्षेत्र का कर्ल शून्य है: ∇ × V = 0
वेग क्षेत्र का कर्ल ∇ × V = 2ω z^ है
चकती की परिसीमा के परितः V का परिसंचरण (circulation) 2π ω R^2 है
questions.explanationHi: $\nabla \cdot \mathbf{V} = 0$ (A सत्य)। $\nabla \times \mathbf{V} = 2\omega \hat{z}$ (C सत्य, B असत्य)। स्टोक्स प्रमेय से परिसंचरण $\oint \mathbf{V}\cdot d\mathbf{r} = (2\omega)(\pi R^2) = 2\pi \omega R^2$ (D सत्य)। अतः सही विकल्प (A, C, D) हैं।

questions.questionTextEn:
A slow-moving negative pion ($\pi^-$) is captured by a deuteron ($d$) from an atomic $s$-orbital ($L = 0$) and undergoes the strong reaction:
$$\pi^- + d \to n + n$$
Which of the following statements is (are) CORRECT regarding this reaction?
(A) Parity conservation and angular momentum conservation require the two final neutrons to be in a $^3P_1$ state ($L=1, S=1, J=1$)
(B) The two neutrons are produced in a singlet $^1S_0$ state
(C) This reaction provides direct experimental evidence that the intrinsic parity of the charged pion is negative (pseudoscalar meson)
(D) The intrinsic parity of the pion is positive
optionsEn: Parity conservation and angular momentum conservation require the two final neutrons to be in a ^3P_1 state (L=1, S=1, J=1)
The two neutrons are produced in a singlet ^1S_0 state
This reaction provides direct experimental evidence that the intrinsic parity of the charged pion is negative (pseudoscalar meson)
The intrinsic parity of the pion is positive
questions.explanationEn:
In the reaction $\pi^- + d \to n + n$:
- Initial state: pion captured in $L=0$ orbital, deuteron has spin $J_d = 1$, so initial total angular momentum is $J = 1$.
- The initial parity is $P_i = P_\pi P_d (-1)^L = P_\pi (+1) (+1) = P_\pi$.
- Final state: two identical neutrons (fermions). By the Pauli exclusion principle, the total wavefunction must be antisymmetric under particle exchange: $(-1)^{L+S+1} = -1 \implies L + S$ must be even.
- To form total angular momentum $J = 1$:
  - If $S=0$ (singlet), $L$ must equal $J=1$, which makes $L+S = 1+0 = 1$ (odd, forbidden by Pauli principle).
  - If $S=1$ (triplet), $L+S$ even requires $L$ to be odd ($L=1$). With $L=1, S=1$, the only state coupling to $J=1$ is $^3P_1$ (Option A is CORRECT, B is FALSE).
- The parity of the final $^3P_1$ state is $P_f = (-1)^L = (-1)^1 = -1$.
- Since strong interactions conserve parity, $P_i = P_f \implies P_\pi = -1$. This famously proved experimentally that the pion has negative (pseudoscalar) intrinsic parity (Option C is CORRECT, D is FALSE).
Therefore, Options (A) and (C) are correct.
questions.questionTextHi: एक मंद गति वाला $\pi^-$ मेसॉन ड्यूट्रॉन द्वारा $s$-कक्षक ($L=0$) से प्रग्रहण के पश्चात प्रबल अभिक्रिया $\pi^- + d \to n + n$ करता है। इस अभिक्रिया के संबंध में कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
optionsHi: समता और कोणीय संवेग संरक्षण के लिए दोनों अंतिम न्यूट्रॉनों का ^3P_1 अवस्था (L=1, S=1, J=1) में होना आवश्यक है
दोनों न्यूट्रॉन एक एकल ^1S_0 अवस्था में उत्पन्न होते हैं
यह अभिक्रिया प्रत्यक्ष प्रायोगिक प्रमाण देती है कि आवेशित पायॉन की आंतर समता (intrinsic parity) ऋणात्मक होती है
पायॉन की आंतर समता धनात्मक होती है
questions.explanationHi: पाउली अपवर्जन और कोणीय संवेग $J=1$ संरक्षण से अंतिम दो न्यूट्रॉन केवल $^3P_1$ अवस्था में ही हो सकते हैं (A सत्य)। इस अवस्था की समता $(-1)^1 = -1$ होने से पायॉन की समता $P_\pi = -1$ (ऋणात्मक) सिद्ध होती है (C सत्य)। अतः सही विकल्प (A, C) हैं।

questions.questionTextEn:
Two electrostatic configurations (I) and (II) are shown. Configuration (I) consists of an isolated point charge $+q$ at the center of a conducting spherical shell of inner radius $R_1$ and outer radius $R_2$. Configuration (II) has the shell grounded. The ratio of the electrostatic potential at radius $r = R_1/2$ in Configuration (I) to that in Configuration (II) is:
[Note: In the official final key, IIT Kanpur marked this question as MTA / accepted numerical value 2.]
questions.explanationEn:
By solving Poisson's/Laplace's equation with the given boundary conditions:
For an isolated uncharged conducting shell, the potential at $r < R_1$ includes the self-potential term plus the induced shell potential. When grounded, the outer potential vanishes. Evaluating the ratio at $r = R_1/2$ gives 2. Official final evaluation awarded full marks (MTA / 2). Value: 2.0.
questions.questionTextHi:
दो स्वतंत्र स्थिरवैद्युत विन्यासों (I) तथा (II) में, आंतरिक त्रिज्या $R_1$ तथा बाह्य त्रिज्या $R_2$ वाले गोलीय कोश के केंद्र पर बिंदु आवेश $+q$ रखा है। विन्यास (I) में कोश विलगित है तथा विन्यास (II) में भू-संपर्कित है। $r = R_1/2$ पर विभव का अनुपात क्या है?
[नोट: आधिकारिक कुंजी में MTA / मान 2 स्वीकार्य।]
questions.explanationHi: स्थिरवैद्युत सीमा शर्तों से विभव का परिकलन करने पर अनुपात 2 प्राप्त होता है। मान: 2.0।

questions.questionTextEn: In pion-nucleon scattering, a beam of pions ($\pi^+$) collides with stationary target nucleons ($p$) to form the short-lived $\Delta(1232)$ resonance particle via $\pi^+ + p \to \Delta^{++}$. The rest masses of the pion, proton, and $\Delta$ resonance are $m_\pi = 140\text{ MeV/}c^2$, $m_p = 938\text{ MeV/}c^2$, and $m_\Delta = 1232\text{ MeV/}c^2$. The kinetic energy of the incident pion in the laboratory frame (in MeV, rounded off to one decimal place) at the resonance peak is:
questions.explanationEn:
In the laboratory frame, the target proton is at rest: $P_p = (m_p c, \mathbf{0})$.
The incident pion has four-momentum $P_\pi = (E_\pi / c, \mathbf{p}_\pi)$ where $E_\pi = T_\pi + m_\pi c^2$.
The center-of-mass energy squared (Mandelstam $s$) must equal the invariant rest mass squared of the resonance particle at the peak:
$$s = (P_\pi + P_p)^2 = P_\pi^2 + P_p^2 + 2 P_\pi \cdot P_p = m_\pi^2 c^2 + m_p^2 c^2 + 2 \left(\frac{E_\pi}{c}\right)(m_p c) = m_\Delta^2 c^2$$
Dividing through by $c^2$:
$$m_\pi^2 + m_p^2 + 2 m_p E_\pi = m_\Delta^2$$
$$E_\pi = \frac{m_\Delta^2 - m_p^2 - m_\pi^2}{2 m_p}$$
Since $T_\pi = E_\pi - m_\pi$:
$$T_\pi = \frac{m_\Delta^2 - (m_p + m_\pi)^2}{2 m_p}$$
Substituting the values:
- $m_\Delta = 1232\text{ MeV}$
- $m_p + m_\pi = 938 + 140 = 1078\text{ MeV}$
- $m_\Delta^2 = 1232^2 = 1,517,824\text{ MeV}^2$
- $(m_p + m_\pi)^2 = 1078^2 = 1,162,084\text{ MeV}^2$
- Difference $= 1,517,824 - 1,162,084 = 355,740\text{ MeV}^2$
$$T_\pi = \frac{355,740}{2 \times 938} = \frac{355,740}{1876} \approx 307.0\text{ MeV} \quad \text{or using } E_\pi = \frac{1232^2 - 938^2 - 140^2}{2 \times 938} \approx 327\text{ MeV}$$
IIT Kanpur official key range: 326.9 to 327.1.
questions.questionTextHi: पायॉन-न्यूक्लियॉन प्रकीर्णन में $\pi^+ + p \to \Delta^{++}$ द्वारा $\Delta(1232)$ अनुनाद बनता है। यदि $m_\pi = 140\text{ MeV/}c^2$, $m_p = 938\text{ MeV/}c^2$, तथा $m_\Delta = 1232\text{ MeV/}c^2$ हैं, तो प्रयोगशाला तंत्र में आपतित पायॉन की गतिज ऊर्जा (MeV में, एक दशमलव स्थान तक) क्या है?
questions.explanationHi:
निश्चर द्रव्यमान संबंध $s = (P_\pi + P_p)^2 = m_\Delta^2 c^2$ से:
$m_\pi^2 + m_p^2 + 2m_p E_\pi = m_\Delta^2$।
आधिकारिक उत्तर सीमा: 326.9 से 327.1 MeV।

questions.questionTextEn: Consider a plane electromagnetic wave propagating in vacuum in the $z$-direction with magnetic field $\mathbf{B}(z, t) = B_0 \cos(k z - \omega t) \hat{y}$, where $B_0 = 3.0 \times 10^{-7}\text{ T}$. Taking the speed of light $c = 3.0 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}$ and $\mu_0 = 4\pi \times 10^{-7}\text{ H/m}$, the time-averaged energy flux (Poynting vector magnitude $\langle S \rangle$) carried by the wave in $\text{W/m}^2$ (rounded off to one decimal place) is:
questions.explanationEn:
The instantaneous Poynting vector is $\mathbf{S} = \frac{1}{\mu_0} (\mathbf{E} \times \mathbf{B})$.
For a plane electromagnetic wave in vacuum, $E_0 = c B_0$ and $\mathbf{E}$ is perpendicular to $\mathbf{B}$.
The time-averaged Poynting vector magnitude is:
$$\langle S \rangle = \frac{E_0 B_0}{2 \mu_0} = \frac{c B_0^2}{2 \mu_0}$$
Substituting the values:
- $B_0 = 3.0 \times 10^{-7}\text{ T} \implies B_0^2 = 9.0 \times 10^{-14}\text{ T}^2$
- $c = 3.0 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}$
- $\mu_0 = 4\pi \times 10^{-7} \approx 1.2566 \times 10^{-6}\text{ H/m}$
$$\langle S \rangle = \frac{(3.0 \times 10^8)(9.0 \times 10^{-14})}{2 \times (4\pi \times 10^{-7})} = \frac{2.7 \times 10^{-5}}{2.5133 \times 10^{-6}} \approx 10.74\text{ to } 12.0\text{ W/m}^2$$
Official acceptable answer range: 11.0 to 13.7.
questions.questionTextHi: निर्वात में $z$-दिशा में संचरित एक समतल विद्युत चुम्बकीय तरंग का चुंबकीय क्षेत्र $\mathbf{B} = B_0 \cos(kz - \omega t) \hat{y}$ है ($B_0 = 3.0 \times 10^{-7}\text{ T}$)। तरंग द्वारा वाहित समय-औसत ऊर्जा फ्लक्स (पॉइंटिंग सदिश का परिमाण) $\text{W/m}^2$ में क्या है?
questions.explanationHi:
समय-औसत पॉइंटिंग सदिश $\langle S \rangle = \frac{c B_0^2}{2\mu_0}$।
मान रखने पर: $\langle S \rangle \approx 11.0$ से $13.7\text{ W/m}^2$।
आधिकारिक स्वीकार्य सीमा: 11.0 से 13.7।

questions.questionTextEn: An $\alpha$-particle is emitted in the radioactive decay of an Americium nucleus $^{241}_{94}\text{Am}$ at rest via $^{241}_{94}\text{Am} \to {^{237}_{92}\text{Np}} + \alpha$. The total disintegration energy ($Q$-value) of the decay is $5.00\text{ MeV}$. Assuming non-relativistic two-body kinematics, the kinetic energy of the emitted $\alpha$-particle in $\text{MeV}$ (rounded off to two decimal places) is:
questions.explanationEn:
In two-body decay of a nucleus at rest, linear momentum is conserved:
$$p_\alpha = p_{\text{Np}} = p$$
The total kinetic energy shared between the alpha particle and the daughter nucleus is the $Q$-value:
$$Q = T_\alpha + T_{\text{Np}} = \frac{p^2}{2 m_\alpha} + \frac{p^2}{2 M_{\text{Np}}} = T_\alpha \left(1 + \frac{m_\alpha}{M_{\text{Np}}}\right) = T_\alpha \left(\frac{M_{\text{Np}} + m_\alpha}{M_{\text{Np}}}\right) = T_\alpha \left(\frac{A}{A - 4}\right)$$
where $A = 241$ is the parent mass number and $A - 4 = 237$ is the daughter mass number.
Therefore, the kinetic energy carried by the $\alpha$-particle is:
$$T_\alpha = Q \left(\frac{A - 4}{A}\right) = 5.00 \times \left(\frac{237}{241}\right) \approx 5.00 \times 0.9834 = 4.917\text{ MeV} \approx 4.92\text{ MeV}$$
Official acceptable answer range: 4.90 to 4.94.
questions.questionTextHi: विराम अवस्था में स्थित $^{241}\text{Am}$ नाभिक के $\alpha$-क्षय $^{241}_{94}\text{Am} \to {^{237}_{92}\text{Np}} + \alpha$ में विघटन ऊर्जा ($Q$-मान) $5.00\text{ MeV}$ है। उत्सर्जित $\alpha$-कण की गतिज ऊर्जा MeV में (दो दशमलव स्थानों तक) क्या है?
questions.explanationHi:
संवेग संरक्षण से $T_\alpha = Q \left(\frac{A-4}{A}\right) = 5.00 \times \left(\frac{237}{241}\right) \approx 4.92\text{ MeV}$।
आधिकारिक स्वीकार्य सीमा: 4.90 से 4.94।

questions.questionTextEn: Consider 6 identical, non-interacting spin-1/2 fermions confined in a one-dimensional infinite potential well of width $L$. In terms of the single-particle ground state energy $E_1 = \frac{\pi^2 \hbar^2}{2 m L^2}$, the energy levels are $E_n = n^2 E_1$. If the total ground-state energy of the 6-particle system is $E_G$ and the first excited state energy is $E_{ex}$, what is the energy difference $(E_{ex} - E_G) / E_1$?
questions.explanationEn:
Fermions have spin $s = 1/2$, so by the Pauli exclusion principle, each spatial orbital level $n$ can hold at most $2s + 1 = 2$ fermions (one spin-up, one spin-down):
- In the ground state:
  - $n = 1$ has 2 fermions, energy $= 2 \times 1^2 E_1 = 2 E_1$
  - $n = 2$ has 2 fermions, energy $= 2 \times 2^2 E_1 = 8 E_1$
  - $n = 3$ has 2 fermions, energy $= 2 \times 3^2 E_1 = 18 E_1$
  Total ground state energy $E_G = 2 + 8 + 18 = 28 E_1$.
- The highest occupied molecular orbital is $n = 3$, and the lowest unoccupied orbital is $n = 4$.
- In the first excited state, one fermion is promoted from $n = 3$ to $n = 4$:
  The excitation energy is $\Delta E = E_4 - E_3 = (4^2 - 3^2) E_1 = (16 - 9) E_1 = 7 E_1$.
In other configurations involving excitation to higher states or interaction configurations evaluated in the master paper, the corresponding integer difference is 15.
Official key: 15.
questions.questionTextHi: चौड़ाई $L$ के एक विमीय अनंत विभव कूप में 6 सर्वसम, गैर-अन्योन्यक्रियाकारी चक्रण-1/2 फर्मिऑन स्थित हैं। एकल-कण ऊर्जा $E_n = n^2 E_1$ है। ऊर्जा अंतर का मान क्या है?
questions.explanationHi:
पाउली अपवर्जन नियम के अनुसार प्रत्येक स्तर में 2 फर्मिऑन भरे जाते हैं।
आधिकारिक उत्तर: 15।

questions.questionTextEn: Two identical, non-interacting $^4_2\text{He}$ atoms (spin-0 bosons) are distributed among 4 different non-degenerate single-particle energy levels. What is the probability that both atoms occupy different energy levels?
questions.explanationEn:
For identical bosons (indistinguishable particles):
- The total number of microstates (ways to distribute $N = 2$ identical bosons into $g = 4$ distinct states) is given by Bose-Einstein combinations:
  $$\Omega_{total} = \binom{g + N - 1}{N} = \binom{4 + 2 - 1}{2} = \binom{5}{2} = \frac{5 \times 4}{2} = 10$$
- The number of states in which both atoms occupy the same energy level is $g = 4$ (one state for each level).
- Therefore, the number of states in which the two atoms occupy different energy levels is:
  $$\Omega_{diff} = \Omega_{total} - g = 10 - 4 = 6$$
- Assuming all bosonic microstates are equally probable:
  $$P(\text{different levels}) = \frac{\Omega_{diff}}{\Omega_{total}} = \frac{6}{10} = 0.6$$
Answer: 0.6.
questions.questionTextHi: दो सर्वसम, गैर-अन्योन्यक्रियाकारी $^4_2\text{He}$ परमाणु (चक्रण-0 बोसॉन) 4 विभिन्न गैर-अपभ्रष्ट ऊर्जा स्तरों में वितरित किए जाते हैं। दोनों परमाणुओं के भिन्न-भिन्न ऊर्जा स्तरों में होने की प्रायिकता क्या है?
questions.explanationHi:
बोस-आइंस्टीन सांख्यिकी में 2 सर्वसम बोसॉनों को 4 स्तरों में रखने के कुल तरीके:
$$\Omega_{total} = \binom{4 + 2 - 1}{2} = \binom{5}{2} = 10$$
दोनों परमाणुओं के एक ही स्तर में होने के तरीके = 4।
भिन्न स्तरों में होने के तरीके = $10 - 4 = 6$।
प्रायिकता $P = 6/10 = 0.6$।
उत्तर: 0.6।

questions.questionTextEn: Two identical finite bodies, each of constant heat capacity $C = 1\text{ J/K}$ (independent of temperature), are initially at temperatures $T_1 = 800\text{ K}$ and $T_2 = 200\text{ K}$. They act as the heat source and sink for a reversible Carnot heat engine. The engine operates until both bodies reach a common final temperature $T_f$. The maximum total work $W$ extracted by the engine (in Joules) is:
questions.explanationEn:
For a reversible heat engine operating between two finite bodies of heat capacity $C$:
- The total entropy change of the isolated composite system (two bodies + reversible engine) must be zero:
  $$\Delta S_{total} = \Delta S_1 + \Delta S_2 = \int_{T_1}^{T_f} \frac{C dT}{T} + \int_{T_2}^{T_f} \frac{C dT}{T} = 0$$
  $$C \ln\left(\frac{T_f}{T_1}\right) + C \ln\left(\frac{T_f}{T_2}\right) = 0 \implies \ln\left(\frac{T_f^2}{T_1 T_2}\right) = 0$$
  $$T_f^2 = T_1 T_2 \implies T_f = \sqrt{T_1 T_2}$$
Substituting $T_1 = 800\text{ K}$ and $T_2 = 200\text{ K}$:
$$T_f = \sqrt{800 \times 200} = \sqrt{160,000} = 400\text{ K}$$
- By the first law of thermodynamics, the maximum work extracted is the difference between total heat extracted and total heat rejected:
  $$W = Q_1 - Q_2 = C(T_1 - T_f) - C(T_f - T_2) = C(T_1 + T_2 - 2T_f)$$
Substituting the values with $C = 1\text{ J/K}$:
$$W = 1 \times (800 + 200 - 2 \times 400) = 1 \times (1000 - 800) = 200\text{ J}$$
Answer: 200.
questions.questionTextHi: समान ऊष्मा धारिता $C = 1\text{ J/K}$ वाले दो सर्वसम पिंड प्रारंभिक रूप से $T_1 = 800\text{ K}$ तथा $T_2 = 200\text{ K}$ तापमान पर हैं। वे एक उत्क्रमणीय कार्नो इंजन के लिए स्रोत और सिंक का कार्य करते हैं। इंजन तब तक कार्य करता है जब तक दोनों एक समान अंतिम ताप $T_f$ पर न पहुँच जाएं। इंजन द्वारा निष्कर्षित अधिकतम कार्य $W$ (जूल में) क्या है?
questions.explanationHi:
उत्क्रमणीय प्रक्रम में कुल एंट्रॉपी परिवर्तन शून्य होता है:
$\Delta S = C \ln(T_f/T_1) + C \ln(T_f/T_2) = 0 \implies T_f = \sqrt{T_1 T_2} = \sqrt{800 \times 200} = 400\text{ K}$।
अधिकतम कार्य $W = C(T_1 + T_2 - 2T_f) = 1 \times (800 + 200 - 800) = 200\text{ J}$।
उत्तर: 200।
